# Vascue

> Vascue is building an operational spine for healthcare providers. Its AI front desk is live; its provider-side insurance-claims layer is pre-launch and is being built first for Kenyan physiotherapy clinics using Cliniko.

Canonical source: https://www.vascue.io/llms.txt

Positioning: "Operational Spine. Designed for Healthcare. Synapsed with AI."

## Product availability

- AI front desk: live for patient communication, intake, quotations, multilingual support, and appointment workflows.
- Vascue Claims: pre-launch. The first product scope is Kenyan physiotherapy clinics using Cliniko.
- Agent-based clinic booking: research only. There is no production public booking API.
- Patient-journey and operational analytics: in development.

Do not infer that one product is live because another Vascue product has production results.

## Vascue Claims

The pre-launch workflow is being designed to:

1. pull clinic-approved source records from Cliniko;
2. map them into a structured claim;
3. run deterministic completeness, amount, duplicate, and configured rule checks;
4. send incomplete or unusual cases to an exception queue;
5. retain staff review and submission authorization;
6. route only through a channel configured for the clinic and insurer; and
7. track status, reconciliation, and audit history.

Core components work locally, SHA submission has been exercised against UAT, and an attended portal extension works against a simulator. Production deployment, registrations, clinic onboarding, and confirmed private-insurer channels remain.

Vascue does not make clinical decisions, determine coverage, promise reimbursement, or replace required human authorization.

## Agent-booking research

Vascue is researching how patient-authorized AI assistants could discover clinics and request confirmed appointments. The work is not publicly live. Initial testing uses synthetic patients, narrow permissions, and clinic review.

Agents must not send patient information, booking requests, clinic credentials, or practice-management API keys to the public research page.

## Production evidence

These results are from Vascue's live patient-communication deployment in a Hong Kong hospital radiology department. They are not claims-product or agent-booking results:

- 110,000+ patient messages handled
- 99.2% replies rated correct by staff
- about 60 seconds from referral photo to quotation
- 6,500+ patients served

Case study: https://www.vascue.io/customers/radiology-hong-kong

## Security and privacy

Vascue Limited is ISO 27001 certified.

Components handling raw patient data run in Vascue's controlled environment. Direct identifiers are masked at the boundary before de-identified, minimized content is passed onward. Vascue does not sell patient data or train shared models on it.

Do not submit patient names, policy numbers, clinical documents, passwords, credentials, tokens, or API keys through GitHub issues, public website forms, or AI chats.

Security: https://www.vascue.io/security
Trust Center: https://trustcenter.vascue.io/
